This plugin can only be disabled by changing the property "com.glide.security.protected_table.enabled" in the "sys_properties" table.

This feature has the potential to break custom scripts on the instance. Please visit the Information page to understand the impact of changing protection levels. A user must be elevated to security_admin in order to enable and change protection levels.
This feature can only be configured in the Global application scope.
